title: Jais 3: Introducing Arabic-centric Agentic AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.10224v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present Jais 3, a fleet of six open, Arabic-centric agentic language models ranging from 0.9B to 375B parameters. Jais 3 is built to complete tasks for Arabic speakers, not only to answer questions in plain text: it is trained to plan multi-step tasks, call tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, operate a terminal, search the web, and read, edit, and produce PDF, spreadsheet, and presentation files, while communicating with the user in Arabic. Instead of pretraining from scratch, we adapt each model of the fully open K2 Horizon fleet to Arabic through continual pretraining, followed by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), final token preference optimization (FTPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We combine natural Arabic text with translated, transliterated, and synthetic Arabic, and replay the base model's own training data to keep its reasoning, agentic, and English abilities. translated_title: Jais 3：推出以阿拉伯语为核心的智能体AI
translated_abstract: 我们推出 Jais 3，这是一组包含六个开源、以阿拉伯语为核心的智能体语言模型，参数规模从 0.9B 到 375B。Jais 3 旨在为阿拉伯语使用者完成任务，而不仅仅是以纯文本回答问题：它经过训练，能够规划多步骤任务、调用工具和模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器、操作终端、搜索网络，以及阅读、编辑和生成 PDF、电子表格和演示文稿文件，同时用阿拉伯语与用户交流。我们没有从零开始预训练，而是通过持续预训练将完全开源的 K2 Horizon 模型系列中的每个模型适配到阿拉伯语，随后进行监督微调（SFT）、最终 token 偏好优化（FTPO）以及基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。我们将自然阿拉伯语文本与翻译、音译和合成的阿拉伯语相结合，并重放基础模型自身的训练数据，以保持其推理、智能体和英语能力。Jais 3 覆盖 Mo（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: Jais 3 是一系列六个开源、以阿拉伯语为核心的智能体大语言模型（0.9B 至 375B 参数），通过对开源 K2 Horizon 模型进行持续预训练、SFT、FTPO 和 RLVR 适配，使其能规划多步任务、调用工具与 MCP 服务器、操作终端、处理 PDF、表格和演示文稿文件，并用阿拉伯语与用户交流。
en_tdlr: Jais 3 introduces a fleet of six open Arabic-centric agentic language models (0.9B–375B parameters), adapted from the fully open K2 Horizon fleet via continual pretraining, SFT, FTPO, and RLVR, enabling multi-step task planning, tool and MCP server calls, terminal operation, and document creation while communicating with users in Arabic.
